risk_summary: The disclosure provides meaningful quantitative detail on returns, leverage reduction, funding, spreads, and collateral, but relies heavily on standard forward-looking disclaimers and conditional language. Key risks include interest-rate normalization, spread widening, rising repurchase-agreement costs, regulatory changes, GSE reform, and market liquidity or valuation reversals. Management presents the balance sheet and liquidity profile as improved, producing a cautiously confident rather than crisis-oriented tone.
